accordions.title: how it works
accordions.html:
Simply select one of our beautiful templates from the drop down box and click “start my design”. This will mean your chosen template will populate as the front and back cover in the editor.


Once you have clicked “start my design” or “start from scratch” you’ll have 2 options; smart creation with AI or create your book manually. 


Smart creation will instantly craft your project for you, picking the best images, skipping duplicates and poor quality shots, while organizing everything without you lifting a finger.


Both options allow you to fully customize your book in the editor. 


The “start from scratch” option allows you to customize your own template from scratch, with placeholders.

accordions.title: product specs
accordions.html:
Our hard cover perfect binding photobooks are available in both a5 (5.8” x 8.3”) & a4 (8.3” x 11.7”) options, with gloss paper finish.


Our lay flat photobooks are only available a4 (8.3” x 11.7”) with premium luster paper finish.


Please note you’ll be able to choose your book type, size & paper options after clicking “order” in the editor

accordions.title: shipping
accordions.html:
We currently ship to Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UAE, the United Kingdom, and the United States.


Shipping times vary depending on where you’re located:


Western Europe: 5–12 business days


Eastern Europe & the US: 10–12 business days


Rest of the world: Around 15 business days, sometimes a bit longer


Please note that delivery may take slightly more time during peak seasons.

accordions.title: 30-day satisfaction guarantee
accordions.html:
We want you to love your creations! So, we offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you’re not happy with your order, please reach out to our support team at support@vectori.com.


If your book arrives damaged or with a printing defect, we’ll happily send you a free reprint. Just contact our team at support@vectori.com and include a few photos of the issue.


Because each book is custom-made, we’re unable to offer refunds or reprints for design errors made during the creation process. Please make sure to double-check your layout, text, and photos before placing your order.
